conviction_note: Every forward item this print could carry was pre-released on 2026-09-28 (Feb-2027 DPU raised to 2,475 yen, first Aug-2027 guide of a record 2,780 yen, Aug-2026 DPU 2,440 reaffirmed after the period had ended), so the release adds only the actual Aug-2026 DPU and a possible further asset sale; the findings sum to +0.25, abs_move 0.75 is a touch under the 0.83 proxy, and p_up 52 is near the non-result. The two numbers differ (+0.25 against +0.03) because the findings are small positive proxies, while the scaled number also carries the crowded margin long (信用倍率 591), which pulls it toward zero.
bar: Aug-2026 (26th period) DPU forecast 2,440 yen, net profit 2,376m yen, set 2026-07-22 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260722/140120260722597238.pdf) and reaffirmed unchanged on 2026-09-28 after the period closed (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260928/140120260928541004.pdf). No 四季報/IFIS figure reachable; company guide used.
positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-10-20: no disclosed position >=0.5% (0.0%, unchanged). 信用倍率 591 (scraped, baseline), so margin longs dwarf margin shorts: a crowded leveraged-retail long and no squeeze fuel. No option skew in Japan. Run-up -1.59% over 20 days and -1.98% over 5. J-REIT ETF 1343 roughly flat over the same fortnight (1,804 on 10-09, 1,797 on 10-21), so the drift is name-specific but small.

findings.finding: The actual Aug-2026 DPU lands against a 2,440-yen forecast that was reaffirmed on 2026-09-28, after the period had closed. Last period's DPU beat its forecast by 5.8% (2,386 against 2,255, with a 差異 notice), but that forecast was set 2.5 months before period end. This one was confirmed after it, so the room for a surprise is a few percent at most.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Feb-2026 DPU beat of +5.8% (短信 2026-04-14 16:30) was followed by -0.74% on 2026-04-15. The Aug-2025 短信 (2025-10-15 16:45, no 差異 notice) was followed by +0.34% on 10-16. DPU beats have not been bought.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly it is priced. The 9-28 reaffirmation after period end makes the 2,440 bar near-certain, and that is why the size is near zero. What is left is the REIT's habit of landing at or above its forecast, which no wire carries for a name this thin.
findings.independence: Same company's 9-28 notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260928/140120260928541004.pdf) states that the Aug-2026 forecast is unchanged. That is a second document on the same line, not an independent signal.

findings.finding: Both forward periods were pre-released on 2026-09-28 with the OKINAWA GRAND MER RESORT acquisition: Feb-2027 DPU raised 1.3% to 2,475 yen, and a first Aug-2027 guide of 2,780 yen, a record carried by gains on sale; ex-gain EPU is 1,322 yen, or 1,543 before one-off renovation costs. The stock moved +0.27% on 2026-09-29. The 短信 will very likely restate those numbers, so no new guide is expected at this print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 7-22 forecast revision (+12.4% DPU, released 15:45) was followed by +1.96% on 7-23. The 9-28 revision (+1.3% DPU plus the new Aug-2027 guide, 16:45) was followed by +0.27% on 9-29.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. The guide was filed three weeks before the print, and the stock has traded on it for 16 sessions. It is filed so that the reader knows the forecast item is pre-released, and it is sized at 0.
findings.independence: Supplementary deck of the same day (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260928/140120260928541062.pdf) carries the DPU and EPU bridge. It is the same release batch.

findings.finding: The 9-28 deck says the manager is running sale processes on about 15% of the portfolio beyond the contracted sales, with offers well above appraisal. This REIT has announced sales and forecast revisions in TDnet batches (7-22, 9-28), so a further sale with a gain could accompany the 短信.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The sale plus DPU raise on 7-22 was followed by +1.96% the next day. The last results batch (2026-04-14) carried no sale, and the stock moved -0.74%.
findings.why_not_priced: Timing is unknown, and the 15% programme sits in a supplementary slide, not in any forecast. If the market priced a sale with this print, the stock would not have drifted -2% into it while the J-REIT ETF held flat. This is an inference about timing, so it is sized small.

outside_window.finding: The Aug-2027 DPU of 2,780 yen depends on the BoJ hiking in Dec-2026 and Mar-2027 (to 1.75%). The manager estimates +7 yen EPU a month for each month the hikes come later. This resolves at BoJ meetings after the window.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is -1.31, almost all of it the margin overhang (信用倍率 591), and the run-up is -1.6%. The findings are flat to mildly positive. The strongest positive the release could carry is a further above-appraisal asset sale with a DPU raise; I looked for it and found only the 15% sale programme with no date, so the call stays close to 50.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: no finding is a negative built on a visible series (rule 1), the set is not negative-tilted, and the strongest positive was searched for (rule 2); open question 3 (a pre-released print moves little) agrees with the draft's sizing
